status_vocabulary.COMPLETE: implemented, verified, externally evidenced and approved - none reached
status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_LOCAL: implemented and tested in this repository; external evidence/approval still missing
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: core mechanism implemented and tested; named production gaps remain
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: cannot proceed without an input only the owner or an environment can provide

components.name: Original master-source artifact
components.done: MASTER.md bytes are not in the supplied archive and no system of record was provided. No reconstruction was written: the checklist forbids passing one off as the original, and nothing here is authoritative enough to reconstruct from. MASTER_SOURCE_STATUS.json records the gap; tools/audit_repository.py fails the exit gate while it stands.
components.remaining: Owner supplies the original MASTER.md (or a signed release archive holding it) with its source-side digest.

components.name: Pinned pk_core dependency
components.done: pk_core is not in the archive and not in the yard; its version and digest are unknown, so nothing can be pinned. The standalone runtime and all v4.3 subsystems import without it; contract.py/component.py still need it. The conformance lane is declared NOT RUN.
components.remaining: Owner supplies pk_core (version + sha256 or a registry coordinate).

components.name: Python packaging/build metadata
components.done: PEP 621 metadata, setuptools backend, requires-python >=3.10, zero runtime dependencies, package-data for schemas. A wheel builds and installs offline in CI job 'package'.
components.remaining: Reproducible-build digest comparison across two hosts; publication target.

components.name: License/notice artifacts
components.done: The license is the owner's decision and was not invented. NOTICE records authorship and that no third-party code is vendored; LICENSING.md lists what the owner must choose. pyproject declares 'LicenseRef-Proprietary-Pending'.

components.name: CI/release automation
components.done: CI runs tests on 3.10-3.13 and under python -O, the repository audit, the NODE_WASM validator lane, wheel build, provenance generation and the release gate (which exits 3 NO_GO by design).
components.remaining: The workflow has never run on a real GitHub runner; branch protection and a protected release environment are repository settings.

components.name: Concrete PK_WASM_HARDENING/1 schema
components.done: Versioned JSON Schema (additionalProperties false), enforced by a strict validator that rejects unknown keywords; every config is validated at propose and again at activation. Structured error codes with outcome and retry class.
components.remaining: Peer (INV-45/INV-29/PLN-04) consumption tests need those components.

components.name: Concrete PK_WASM_INSTANCE/1 schema
components.done: Request/state/refusal document, lifecycle states with a legal-transition table, deadline and idempotency fields, bounded retry for retryable codes only.
components.remaining: Cancellation and deadlines are declared in the schema but not enforced by the Python model, which has no long-running execution to cancel.

components.name: Production Swivel/compiler/runtime integration
components.done: No Swivel toolchain, pinned Wasm runtime, or Spectre test hardware is available. The verifier binds a toolchain identity and refuses unapproved ones, but no receipt in this repository was produced by Swivel, and nothing here proves a Spectre mitigation was applied.
components.remaining: Swivel (or chosen successor) pinned by digest, a real compile of fixtures, and Spectre PoC evidence on target CPUs.

components.name: Cryptographic compiled-output verifier
components.done: Structural Wasm validator (cross-checked against V8 WebAssembly.validate in the NODE_WASM lane) plus digest-bound, toolchain-bound, hardening-profile-bound receipts with freshness. TenantGateway requires a receipt; the Boolean path remains for pk_core compatibility and is marked legacy.
components.remaining: HMAC is symmetric (asymmetric keys/KMS pending); structural validation is not semantic validation; no Swivel output to verify.

components.name: Signed provenance/attestation
components.done: in-toto Statement v1 with SLSA v1 predicate over every file, DSSE PAE envelope, verify re-hashes subjects. Signature is HMAC-SHA256.
components.remaining: Asymmetric/Sigstore signing and key custody; a hosted builder identity.

components.name: Declarative configuration/provenance subsystem
components.done: Immutable versions, parent-digest chain, author/version/reason/activation-by/at, CAS activation with atomic os.replace, rollback without rewriting history, tamper detection, partial hardening refused before activation.
components.remaining: Approval workflow for config changes (who may activate) is not bound to people.

components.name: Identity/capability enforcement layer
components.done: Authenticated Principal (bare strings refused), HMAC-sealed capability tokens with expiry and revocation, explicit operations, import allowlist eliminating ambient host functions, fail-closed on clock/revocation loss.
components.remaining: No real IdP, mTLS, node/peer attestation, or KMS; keys are constructor arguments.

components.name: Tenant isolation integration
components.done: One gateway per tenant, cross-tenant principals refused, per-tenant quotas, duplicate live instance names refused, per-tenant metrics and audit.
components.remaining: Host isolation (process/VM, caches, kernel, FS, network, devices) is not provable in-process and needs the component 8 runtime.

components.name: Tamper-evident security audit log
components.done: Hash-chained, optionally HMAC'd JSONL with fsync, secret redaction before hashing, and external head anchoring that detects tail truncation (tested both ways).
components.remaining: Where the head anchor and log are shipped (WORM storage, retention) is an operations decision.

components.name: Production observability stack
components.done: All five contract signals plus admission/authz/tenant/load-shed counters and an instantiation histogram, Prometheus text exposition, cardinality guard, redacted structured JSON logs with trace/span ids, per-decision explanations in the audit log, alert rules as data.
components.remaining: No Prometheus/Alertmanager/tracing backend provisioned; fuel_exhaustions is declared but only counted when callers route traps through metrics.

components.name: Performance certification suite
components.done: Measured micro-benchmarks for step, grow, parse, receipt verify, full gateway admit, audit append; results carry host facts and are labelled MEASURED, thresholds UNAPPROVED.
components.remaining: Real Swivel overhead vs. baseline, soak/fleet/power runs, approved SLO thresholds.

components.name: Fault/disaster testing suite
components.done: Process-local faults: audit sink failure refuses admission, clock and revocation loss fail closed, crash mid-activation keeps the old pointer, concurrent burst sheds with an intact chain.
components.remaining: Node/VM/site/network partition and failover testing needs an environment.

components.name: Operations/governance artifacts
components.done: Templates filled with everything the repository knows: SHALL-level requirements with stable ids, precedence rules, runbook per failure code, compatibility policy, waiver register. Owner, approver and escalation fields are UNASSIGNED and the ADR is PROPOSED.
components.remaining: Owner names people, approves the ADR, signs waivers.

components.name: External machine-readable release evidence
components.done: Evidence bundle with manifest digest, test result, matrix summary, per-component status and named blockers; gate evaluates to NO_GO. A falsifier test proves GO is reachable with synthetic inputs and each single omission is NO_GO.
components.remaining: pk_core PK_GATE_RESULTS and a human release approval.
